checks.wanted: the room that would take the longest to clear out
sand that has not gathered into a single heap
something that fell straight down without spreading out
as close to a flat sheet as this gets
the room the engine had to work hardest on
a heap you could not step over

note: Descriptions written to be hard, after the tool was finished, to answer the obvious objection to the set built into world.py: that it was written by the same hand. Negations, synonyms, a figure of speech, and one indirection. Seven of eight. The one that misses asks how long a room would take to clear out, which is a hop from how much is in it, and the pick goes to the water rather than to the room holding three times as much - not a close comparison, a hop too many. Two of the eight were marked wrong at first and both were the rule, not the judging: stepping over a heap is about its height and was marked on slenderness.
